content:
Alyssa Chen: Drafting a compact field brief for security-conscious buyers. Working name 'Velocity Brief'. Need: crisp benchmark callout, webinar hook, and inbound routing rules for leads that mention security, SLAs, or private deployments. Posting a short draft for quick feedback.

Mike R: Uploaded draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/velocity-brief-draft. Suggest headline: 'Up to 3x faster median latency with predictable SLAs' (avoid hyperbole).

Jordan Lee: Add benchmark context: test workload = 2k-token mixed chat+generation, 4 concurrent streams. Internal run: median 280ms -> 95ms; p99 improved similarly; cost ~40% lower per token with batching + prefix caching. Put methodology note in a tiny callout.

Samira Patel: Inbound routing rules suggestion below. Tagging leads with security/private-deploy goes to AE+SE queue and triggers Solutions Workshop invite.

Samira Patel: ```
# inbound routing pseudo-config
if lead.tags contains any of ["security","private-deploy","on-prem","vpc"] then
  assign.team = "enterprise-ae"
  assign.people = ["AE-priority","SE-security"]
  followup = "schedule-solutions-workshop"
end
```

Noah Gomez: Add a form checkbox: 'Require private/VPC or Dedicated capacity?' If yes, auto-tag. Webinar CTA: 'See private deployments + SLA walkthrough'.

Jordan Lee: Proposed webinar flow: 20m benchmark walkthrough, 25m live Q&A with SE, 15m compliance breakout. Title A/B test: compliance-focused vs product-focused.

Mike R: One-pager layout: top-left problem statement (security + predictability), top-right benchmark snapshot, middle deployment matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) with SLA/isolation/pricing bullets, bottom CTA + routing snippet + webinar link.

Alyssa Chen: Action items: Mike finalize copy EOD; Jordan make 2-slide benchmark viz; Samira/Noah finalize routing and form tags. I'll assemble the one-pager and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow. :calendar:

marketing-bot: Reminder set: 'Velocity Brief finalize' tomorrow 10:00 AM PST.
